title: Difference of finite set measures
statement: Let $\mu$ be a finite measure on a measurable space $E$, and let $C,D\subseteq E$. Then $|\mu(C)-\mu(D)|\le\mu(C\mathbin{\triangle}D)$, where $C\mathbin{\triangle}D$ is their symmetric difference and the measures are viewed as real numbers.
replaced: Let $\mu$ be a finite measure on a measurable space $E$, and let $C,D\subseteq E$ be arbitrary sets. Then $|\mu(C)-\mu(D)|\le\mu(C\mathbin{\triangle} D)$, where all values are viewed as finite real numbers.
